claim_matrix.claim: Flexible skill discovery: returns up to 8 relevant skill cards per prompt (configurable via AE_MAX_SKILL_CARDS); agents choose which to read/use from suggestions

section_8_1_capability_status_contract.details: Two dimensions implemented: (1) Implementation status in manifests (plugin-catalog/catalog.json status: integrated/integrated-ready; mcp-servers.json status: built/to-install) validated by catalog-validate.py. (2) Runtime readiness computed per host/provider via api_config.server_state() (visible/hidden with reasons: local_tools_available, configured, not_configured, missing_credentials, runtime_not_configured, executable_not_installed, disabled, disabled_by_default). Skills readiness via link-skills.sh --status and entry_readiness() in registry.py. Parent status never implies child status. Unready capabilities listed with diagnosis but not offered as healthy. Reference configs not presented as native activation; to-install not claimed as installed.
evidence: unified-integration/scripts/registry.py: usable_entries() filters MCPs by visibility

section_8_2_env_vars_immutable_interface.details: All 15 env vars listed in CONTRACT §8.2 and docs/CONFIGURATION.md §Environment Variables match implementation. Retired vars (AGENT_ENHANCEMENTS_MODEL_FILE, AGENT_ENHANCEMENTS_PREFLIGHT_API_KEY) documented as retired in CONFIGURATION.md §224-228 and not read at runtime. New vars require updating both CONTRACT and CONFIGURATION.md per §8.2 rule. Scripts resolve installation root from own location first (R003).
evidence: CONTRACT.md:332-358 §8.2 lists all vars with purpose/default

section_8_3_file_paths_canonical.details: Canonical paths in CONTRACT §8.3 match actual file structure. setup.sh, update-skills.sh, launch-agent.sh at unified-integration root. Config, prompts, skills, memory, compression, scripts subdirs exist. MCP servers in unified-integration/mcp-servers/. All paths use AGENT_ENHANCEMENTS_BASE_DIR/AGENT_ENHANCEMENTS_UNIFIED_DIR env vars.

section_8_4_context_budget_contract.details: context_budget.py enforces limits: L0 bootstrap map <=1000 tokens (build-library-map.py --check), cold start <=4000 (tested in smoke-adaptive-preflight.py), memory recall <=600, observer ambient <=250, search page <=800/5 cards, detail page <=1200, native desc <=2500, tool schema <=1800. MAX_SKILL_CARDS=8 enforced. --set all never default (audited via link-skills.sh --audit). Scale fixture 1x/5x/10x keeps L0 growth <=200 tokens (discovery_benchmark.py). Tiktoken o200k_base proxy used.

section_8_5_adaptive_preflight_contract.details: Fully implemented per CONTRACT §8.5 and ADAPTIVE_PREFLIGHT.md. ui.api.json preflight section (schema v2) is single config source. Mode 0/1/2 with exact integer validation. Mode 2 key from api_keys[api_key_ref] only (no env/keyring/model.json). Selector never executes, sees bounded intent + compact catalog + local lookup pages. Output: selected (1-12 typed IDs), abstain, lookup (1-4 queries), unresolved. Validation: typed IDs resolve exactly, skill delivery requires existing file, MCP requires api_config.server_state visibility, one unavailable required -> Mode 0 fallback. Package rendered inside UserPromptSubmit slot (MAX_SKILL_CARDS, 400 tokens), structured shrinking before clamp, registry_revision digest included. Deadline: monotonic per prompt (default 2s, AE_PREFLIGHT_DEADLINE_MS), socket timeouts derived, no auto-retries (429/5xx/timeout/refusal/invalid JSON -> Mode 0). Mode 1: adapter supplies ae_native_selection, validated by same handler, no auto-switch to Mode 2. Diagnostics: one bounded stderr line per fallback, stdout reserved for context. 73 regression tests in test_adaptive_preflight.py + live opt-in.
evidence: unified-integration/scripts/registry.py: paged_search, paged_list, find_entry (exact typed ID)

section_8_6_checkout_local_runtime_state.details: All AE-owned state under checkout's .agentenhancements/ (gitignored, 0700): runtime/venv, config (host-selection.json, legacy model.json/preflight.key imported once), memory (SQLite + task-observer), cache (Python/uv/pip/npm/Cargo/model). AGENT_ENHANCEMENTS_STATE_DIR provides absolute isolation override. Native agent config is bridge only (commands/hooks/symlinks point to checkout). Setup refreshes owned paths after relocation, preserves user config. No implicit global state import. Cargo builds to headroom/target inside checkout. Audit logs in unified-integration/memory/audit/.
evidence: unified-integration/scripts/project_paths.py: config_root(), runtime_root(), memory_root() all under checkout

discrepancies.area: README claim: '10 bundled Python backends, 9 enabled by default'
discrepancies.actual: api_config.py BUILTINS lists 10 backends; DEFAULT_DISABLED = {'task-router-mcp'} so 9 enabled. However, 'search-mcp' is hidden until at least one provider key is configured (you/tavily/exa/firecrawl/newsapi/serper), so effectively 8 visible by default with empty keys. arXiv and Google News RSS remain available keyless.

discrepancies.area: README claim: 'Full agent parity: lifecycle hooks, native skill discovery, MCP gateway, memory persistence, and compression'
discrepancies.actual: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode have full parity. Hermes has MCP gateway + lifecycle callbacks but no native skill directory linking. Cursor/Gemini/Windsurf/Copilot/Kiro have reference configs only (no hooks, no native skill discovery, no MCP gateway). Agent Skills harnesses only get skill linking.

discrepancies.area: README claim: 'Context compression (headroom) - 20% token reduction for coding tasks, 60-95% reduction for JSON/logs'
discrepancies.actual: Headroom compression ratios are aspirational/upstream claims. Fallback compression in compress.py has 50k char cap and mode-specific processing but no guaranteed ratios. Native CLI compaction remains separate. Config.yaml budgets are reference template — no shipped code consumes automatically.

discrepancies.area: README claim: 'System prompts... are not injected into any agent automatically'
discrepancies.actual: True for all agents. However, universal-system-prompt.txt and per-agent prompts are copied to unified-integration/prompts/ and referenced in agent configs (e.g., Gemini config.yaml has system_prompt pointing to it). The prompts are available but not forced.

discrepancies.area: Plugin catalog claim: '40 curated external plugin entries from 22 unique upstream repositories'
discrepancies.actual: 19 Agency division packs all from same upstream (msitarzewski/agency-agents). So 22 unique upstreams = 1 (agency-agents) + 21 others. Count is correct but '22 unique upstream repositories' phrasing could imply more diversity.

discrepancies.area: MCP roadmap claim: '41 MCP servers (built: 11, to-install: 30)'
discrepancies.actual: mcp-servers.json has 41 entries. However, 'agent_browser' is listed as 'built' but implementation is at mcp-servers/agent_browser/src/index.js (Node.js, not Python). The '10 bundled Python backends' count excludes agent_browser. Search-mcp is built but hidden without keys.

key_findings: Core claims (skill/plugin/MCP counts, agent parity for top 3, native skill linking, flexible discovery, context budgets, adaptive preflight) are well-implemented and tested with 73+ regression tests for preflight alone.
CI runs full test suite including ECC tests, MCP server health checks, headroom build, capability count verification, and markdown linting.
Documentation overclaims 'full agent parity' for all 9 agents; only Claude/Codex/OpenCode have full native lifecycle integration.

Configuration contract (§8.1-8.6) is faithfully implemented with two-dimension capability status, immutable env var interface, canonical paths, context budgets, adaptive preflight, and checkout-local state.

Plugin catalog correctly distinguishes 'integrated' (vendored+wired) vs 'integrated-ready' (guide only); MCP roadmap correctly distinguishes 'built' vs 'to-install' with runtime readiness computed separately.
